explanation: At D1 the value is almost always 0-1 (1-2 when the previous trial was unrewarded). At GO it depends on the choice: choosing a2 gives 9-10 (7-8 just after an unrewarded trial or a switch), choosing a1 gives about 5 (6-8 just after an unrewarded trial). At D2 it depends only on the state reached: S1 gives 5-8 (about 6 on average), S2 gives 1-3.
